name: Gopi Goa Indian Restaurant
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Gopi Goa Indian Restaurant in Tirol

** **

Discover authentic Indian flavors in the heart of Tirol!** At **Gopi Goa Indian Restaurant**, we bring the vibrant tastes of India straight to your table. Located near **Innsbruck**, our cozy yet lively restaurant offers a warm welcome and a menu bursting with traditional dishes, from fragrant curries to mouthwatering biryanis. Whether you're craving a spicy **Vindaloo** or a creamy **Butter Chicken**, our chefs prepare every meal with love and care, using the finest spices and fresh ingredients. **

Why Choose Gopi Goa?

** **
    ** **
  • Authentic Indian Cuisine:** Experience the true flavors of India, just like in **Goa** or **Hyderabad**.
    • ** **
  • Fresh & Spicy:** Every dish is made with fresh herbs and spices, ensuring a burst of authentic taste.
    • ** **
  • Cozy Atmosphere:** Enjoy your meal in a relaxed setting, perfect for families, friends, or a romantic dinner.
    • ** **
  • Vegetarian & Non-Vegetarian Options:** From **Dal Makhani** to **Tandoori Chicken**, we cater to all preferences.
    • ** **
  • Takeaway & Catering:** Bring the taste of India home or order for your next event.
    • ** **
** **

Must-Try Dishes

** **
    ** **
  • **Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)**** – Tender chicken in a rich, creamy tomato gravy.
    • ** **
  • **Hyderabadi Biryani**** – Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced meat and vegetables.
    • ** **
  • **Goan Fish Curry**** – A tangy, coconut-based curry with fresh seafood.
    • ** **
  • **Garlic Naan & Roti**** – Warm, fluffy bread to soak up every last drop of sauce.
    • ** **
  • **Mango Lassi**** – A refreshing yogurt drink, sweet and creamy.
    • ** **
** **

Visit Us

** **

Find us in the heart of Tirol, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Whether you're exploring the **Alps**, visiting **Hallstatt**, or simply craving a taste of India, **Gopi Goa** is your go-to spot for an unforgettable dining experience.

** **

Come taste the magic of India—one delicious bite at a time!

**
